confirm.title: Save household
confirm.description: Save these selections? HomeCircle reads existing entities only. You can edit your selections in Options. Cancel to discard all changes.

supporting.title: Optional evidence for this member
supporting.description:
Member: {person}

Select only sensors that describe this member. Battery must use %. Driving is current only with an explicit report timestamp no older than five minutes; otherwise it is last reported or unverified. HA observation times are never GPS report times. Bind the location report timestamp to the exact source it describes. Clear a field to remove a mapping.
